Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: The plan provides a comprehensive district-wide inventory with detailed information on building age, size, types, and specialized spaces (e.g., classrooms, library, multipurpose rooms). It includes a robust condition assessment covering major systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, roofing) with Facility Condition Index (FCI) data and detailed capital needs forecasts, connecting condition data to long-term capital planning (Chunks 1-3).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: No mention or analysis of enrollment projections, capacity utilization, or demographic trends was found in the provided plan content.

Educational Alignment.justification: The plan references principal priorities such as science space, landscaping, and technology updates, indicating some awareness of educational goals, but lacks detailed educational specifications or connections between facility projects and instructional needs (Chunk 1).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: The plan mentions landscaping and conversion of some buildings to landscape areas, with limited description of outdoor spaces. However, it lacks detailed data or districtwide strategies for greening, shade, or outdoor learning (Chunks 1-3).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: No mention of climate risks, climate readiness, or mitigation strategies related to climate change was found in the plan content.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: The plan notes updates to HVAC and electrical systems and presence of solar panel structures, indicating some energy efficiency efforts, but lacks comprehensive data, resilience strategies, or references to state requirements such as Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals (Chunks 1-3).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: The plan provides detailed capital needs estimates with itemized costs by building system and a 10-year expenditure forecast. It outlines a framework for prioritizing projects based on condition and lifecycle needs but lacks explicit discussion of funding sources or a comprehensive financial strategy (Chunks 2-3).
